pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

lens_moon.desc: the Moon Lens: a crescent of glass in a silver rim; pivot at its foot, set in the socket

socket_moon.desc: the moon socket: a stone stand whose cap holds an empty crescent; the lens's pivot goes at (0, 6.6), its shape over the recess; pivot at the base's middle

beam_moon.desc: the moon beam: an effect texture (soft alpha, like the game's IA4 effects); map it round a tall cylinder from the lens to the ceiling, additive or alpha-blended; its bottom is the bright end

lens_sun.desc: the Sun Lens: a round of glass in a gold rim; pivot at its foot, set in the socket

socket_sun.desc: the sun socket: a stone stand whose cap holds an empty circle; the lens's pivot goes at (0, 6.6), its shape over the recess; pivot at the base's middle

beam_sun.desc: the sun beam: an effect texture (soft alpha, like the game's IA4 effects); map it round a tall cylinder from the lens to the ceiling, additive or alpha-blended; its bottom is the bright end

lens_tear.desc: the Tear Lens: a teardrop of glass in a blue rim; pivot at its foot, set in the socket

socket_tear.desc: the tear socket: a stone stand whose cap holds an empty teardrop; the lens's pivot goes at (0, 6.6), its shape over the recess; pivot at the base's middle

beam_tear.desc: the tear beam: an effect texture (soft alpha, like the game's IA4 effects); map it round a tall cylinder from the lens to the ceiling, additive or alpha-blended; its bottom is the bright end

lens_in_socket: the lens's pivot sits at the socket's (0, 6.6)
